title: Requirement extraction — Tool Selection Planner (Signature)
description:
Signature edition — an original Signature-authored completion, clearly labeled as Signature work and never presented as public record. The tool selection planner chooses the right tool for each task from the registry: it matches the task's requirements against registered capabilities, scores candidates on fit, cost, reliability, and policy, and explains its choice. Good selection is the difference between an agent that flails through five wrong tools and one that does the job in a single confident call. The planner learns from outcomes, promoting tools that actually deliver.

This record documents the requirement extraction approach: Turn the task description into structured requirements: verbs, data types, constraints.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.

Every record in this database is the full fully-formed file with all data — never a stub or description alone. This database holds 15 of the 1,000,000 target — the march to a million is in progress.
demo:
# Tool Selection Planner demo: requirement match -> policy filter -> scored pick.
TOOLS={"t-translate":{"verbs":["translate"],"cost":2,"rel":0.98,"offline":False},
       "t-local":{"verbs":["translate"],"cost":0,"rel":0.85,"offline":True},
       "t-summarize":{"verbs":["summarize"],"cost":1,"rel":0.97,"offline":True}}
def select(verbs,policy):
    cands=[]
    for name,t in TOOLS.items():
        if not set(verbs)<=set(t["verbs"]): continue
        if policy.get("offline") and not t["offline"]: continue
        score=0.6*t["rel"]-0.1*t["cost"]+(0.2 if t["offline"] and policy.get("offline") else 0)
        cands.append((round(score,3),name))
    return sorted(cands,reverse=True)
print(select(["translate"],{"offline":True}))

# Tool Selection Planner demo: requirement match -> policy filter -> scored pick.
TOOLS={"t-translate":{"verbs":["translate"],"cost":2,"rel":0.98,"offline":False},
       "t-local":{"verbs":["translate"],"cost":0,"rel":0.85,"offline":True},
       "t-summarize":{"verbs":["summarize"],"cost":1,"rel":0.97,"offline":True}}
def select(verbs,policy):
    cands=[]
    for name,t in TOOLS.items():
        if not set(verbs)<=set(t["verbs"]): continue
        if policy.get("offline") and not t["offline"]: continue
        score=0.6*t["rel"]-0.1*t["cost"]+(0.2 if t["offline"] and policy.get("offline") else 0)
        cands.append((round(score,3),name))
    return sorted(cands,reverse=True)
print(select(["translate"],{"offline":True}))
print(select(["translate"],{}))
